vibration.name: Wind Turbine Gearbox Condition Monitoring Vibration Analysis Benchmarking Datasets
vibration.publisher: National Renewable Energy Laboratory / U.S. Department of Energy
quality_rules: use original downloaded files only
record healthy/damaged label from source documentation
keep source filename in imported waveform JSON
reject files without numeric vibration channels
reject vibration series shorter than the configured minimum sample count

vibration.name: Wind Turbine Blades Fault Diagnosis based on Vibration Dataset Analysis
quality_rules: use original downloaded files only
record source condition label
preserve sample rate from dataset documentation
reject nonnumeric or empty vibration columns

scada.name: CARE to Compare - Wind Turbine SCADA Data For Early Fault Detection
scada.quality_note: Use version 6 or newer. The Zenodo landing page states that the second version contained erroneous values and that data were updated in February 2025.
quality_rules: use original downloaded CSV files only
preserve source filename and DOI
map source timestamp and sensor columns explicitly
reject rows with missing timestamp
do not invent turbine identity beyond dataset metadata

blade_images.name: DTU - Drone inspection images of wind turbine
blade_images.publisher: Mendeley Data / Technical University of Denmark
quality_rules: use original downloaded images only
preserve image filename and dataset DOI
reject images below configured minimum resolution
do not invent labels when no annotation is present

blade_images.name: YOLO Annotated Wind Turbine Surface Damage
blade_images.publisher: Kaggle dataset derived from DTU drone inspection images
quality_rules: use image and YOLO label pairs only
store bounding boxes converted from source YOLO labels
do not create model confidence for manual labels
skip samples with invalid label geometry

weather.name: ERA5 hourly data on single levels from 1940 to present
quality_rules: use only when turbine or farm coordinates and timestamp range are available
record request bounding box, variables, time range and CDS dataset id
do not replace SCADA wind speed or site measurements with ERA5 values
mark weather values as contextual reanalysis data
